steps.title: Analyze Existing Code and Requirements
steps.description: Review current Hello App configurations and identify the application theme references.

steps.title: Update Android Manifest Theme
steps.description: Modify the application theme configuration in AndroidManifest.xml from Theme.Material.Light to Theme.Material.

steps.title: Adjust Main Layout for Dark Theme
steps.description: Update the background and text color settings inside activity_main.xml to offer standard high-contrast look suitable with Theme.Material.

steps.title: Verify App Metadata
steps.description: Ensure the root app-meta.json file contains correct matching properties for package name and app name.

steps.title: Verify Android Namespace Configuration
steps.description: Ensure standard XML namespace URI is maintained correctly across manifest layout properties.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Execute build processes with Gradle to package and compile the application with its new Material Dark theme.
